confirmed_driver_cause: The Showcase native driver's top-level catch discarded the caught exception and retained only organization_failed. The organization helper had no fixed substage or bounded observation callback, so the receipt could not distinguish picker, selection, storage, or rendered-identity failure.
repair: The shared organization helper emits fixed substage names and safe boolean observations on every picker and storage sample, including the last sample before a timeout. A missing sample remains null rather than false. The Showcase checkpoint binds those callbacks to the production receipt, verifies the admin-role result before recording it, and maps only allowlisted error labels to a failure code. Unknown messages and resource refusal details remain bounded. No product behavior, retry, or timeout changed.

red_green.original_receipt_red: An assertion for organization_diagnostic.substage against the hosted run receipt failed with organization_substage_missing.
red_green.mutation_red: Replacing the stage callback assignment with a constant resource_gate, replacing each timeout sample with null, and dropping the checkpoint's observation callback each made the real driver receipt test fail; plant.py restored identical bytes after each mutation.
red_green.green: The actual organization helper and shared checkpoint passed picker false, picker unknown, storage false, and selected-organization cases. The failure cases passed through the production driver's catch and receipt writer; settings-native-auth-driver tests passed.

findings_addressed: The timeout read now publishes bounded last-sampled picker/storage booleans; a failed read remains null.
The receipt test runs the real organization helper via the same checkpoint used by native acceptance, and no-op callback mutations fail it.
